latestVersion.changelog:
**Major update: Open-source-first router, GLM-5 default, and infrastructure overhaul.**

- Switched model routing to open-source-first: GLM-5 is now default; Claude only used as fallback.
- Added full GLM-5 and GLM-4.7 Flash integration for all inference and planning tasks.
- Upgraded Gateway Guardian to version 5 with direct curl probes (reducing Signal notification spam).
- Implemented multi-key auth rotation v2, three-shift cyclic execution engine, and 24/7 macOS power config.
- Reorganized scripts and security tools; removed bundled security subskills and deprecated files.
- Introduced new setup.mjs workflow for one-step agent and gateway configuration.
